title: Hearthline Pause Discovery State
description: A member-controlled state that excludes active discovery objects from new candidate generation. It is not a presence state, ghost mode, profile-view record, or hidden activity signal.
$comment: Forbidden fields include onlineStatus, lastActiveAt, nearbyStatus, currentLocation, locationHistory, profileViews, viewedProfileRefs, hiddenBrowsingHistory, deviceActivity, WebSocketPresence, sessionDuration, engagementScore, pauseReason, riskScore, trustScore, or visibilityPenalty.
